# opentel-mcp — full-text scaffold

This file will contain the complete text of every docs page concatenated
as clean markdown, per the llms-full.txt convention. It is currently a
scaffold — placeholder doc content is still in place (see
CLAUDE.md / DECISIONS.md, "Round 1" — real doc content lands in Round 2).

Once real content is written, this file should be regenerated from the
`docs` Velite collection (concatenating each entry's compiled markdown in
DOCS_NAV order) rather than maintained by hand.
